correctness_gate: An output with nonzero frozen test exit is a loss and is excluded from simplicity/maintainability comparison; no simpler-wrong credit.
primary_beat_rule: Against DIRECT on pairs where both outputs pass: arm must have negative paired median on at least two of lines, cyclomatic, and new concepts, add no more nonstdlib dependencies in median, and be preferred to DIRECT by the blinded judge on more than half of their head-to-head eligible comparisons. Report counts and uncertainty; do not infer from correctness-only pairs.
falsification: If neither STRUCTURAL nor HUMAN beats DIRECT under the primary beat rule, close with the null under tested conditions. HUMAN beats while STRUCTURAL does not diagnoses retrieval/mapping bottleneck.
label_rotation: For each problem, sort arms by sha256(problem_id + colon + arm), then map in that order to labels A,B,C,D. Judge receives no arm prompt/context and returns ranking plus rationale.
semantic_retrieval: Deterministic Jaccard on lexical tokens over repository Python files excluding this experiment; highest score/path tie-break; first 3500 characters frozen.
structural_retrieval: Deterministic Jaccard over abstract relation-tag sets; score then source id tie-break; role map formed only by joining shared abstract role keys.

amendment_1_before_generation.trigger: User sharpened claim: existence of an analogy-caused different, non-worse plan by an LLM-based system.
creative_case_gate: analogy plan contains a mechanism absent from default plan
transferred mechanism is explicitly linked to source relation
same-seed analogue-removal ablation reverts to default
amendment_1_before_generation.m5_scope_limit: Codex subscription does not expose a seed in this harness. M5 can screen candidates and compare arms, but cannot by itself establish causal reversion. Never label an M5 difference a creative jump.
amendment_1_before_generation.followup: For 2-3 screened candidates, run a bounded provider/model configuration that exposes deterministic seed or verifiably deterministic temperature-zero behavior with identical prompt/seed and analogue-only ablation; persist request parameters and repeatability check.
amendment_1_before_generation.additional_control: A correct, well-worked, detail/length-matched but structurally irrelevant solved analogue. If it produces the different/non-worse plan, classify as example-quality effect, not relational transfer.
amendment_1_before_generation.existence_reporting: Report any fully traced case individually and report the denominator/failures; aggregate superiority is not required for the existence claim.
